notes.scul: After another app or a locked screen in flight, nothing says how long you flew dark. Further along your course by ship or on foot, the Log fills that part in.
notes.plain: After another app or a locked screen on a ride, no pop-up says part wasn't tracked. Further along your route by bike or on foot, the Log fills that part in.

notes.scul: The sandworm you'll catch now has an arrow for the way it heads, and shows in the course preview too when it is due within 30 minutes.
notes.plain: Bus stops now show pancake's bus stop sign. The round yellow bus marks only the bus you'll catch, with an arrow for the way it heads.

notes.scul: Sandworm nests show with Layers' Comets, every one as before. With it off, in the course preview and in flight, only your course's own nests show.
notes.plain: The bus you'll catch shows in the route preview too, if due within 30 min. Layers' Trains is now Transit: off, or on a ride, only your route's bus stops show.

notes.scul: In Plain words, Layers' Terrain is now Climbs: pancake's design, three colors for how steep the ground is. SCUL's Terrain is as it was.
notes.plain: Layers' Terrain is now Climbs, to pancake's design: three colors show how steep the ground is. The uphill marks in its picture come to the map later.

notes.scul: A new switch under Battery saver, 3D terrain, sets whether hills rise when you tilt the chart with Terrain on.
notes.plain: Battery saver no longer turns Climbs off. A new switch under Battery saver, 3D terrain, sets whether hills rise when you tilt the map with Climbs on.

notes.scul: On foot, the course you pick in the course preview now shows its details inside its own box, right under its bar, as it does by ship.
notes.plain: On foot, the route you pick in the route preview now shows its details inside its own box, right under its bar, as it does by bike.

notes.scul: A course's sandworm or comet part is now drawn as a solid line in its line's color. Space walks stay dotted.
notes.plain: A route's bus or train part is now drawn as a solid line in its line's color. Walking parts stay dotted.

notes.scul: A place's, comet station's or sandworm nest's peek now has pancake's round buttons, as big as the chart's. A bike beside a scheduled time stays in full color.
notes.plain: A place's, station's or bus stop's pop-up now has pancake's round buttons, as big as the map's. A bike beside a scheduled time stays in full color.

notes.scul: Every walking icon is now pancake's. By night the parking sign is light gray like the bike racks. Weather's Light, Steady and Heavy radiation show whole marks.
notes.plain: Every walking icon is now pancake's. By night the parking sign is light gray like the bike racks. Weather's Light, Steady and Heavy rain show whole marks.

notes.scul: On a first visit the chart could stay without buildings and places after its download, until a restart. It now checks that it switched and tries again if not.
notes.plain: On a first visit the map could stay without buildings and places after its download, until a restart. It now checks that it switched and tries again if not.

notes.scul: Nearly every tap that opened nothing for lack of room now opens a peek: over what you tapped, or with the course preview sliding down until the peek closes.
notes.plain: Nearly every tap that opened nothing for lack of room now opens a pop-up: over what you tapped, or with the route preview sliding down until the pop-up closes.

notes.scul: Over a course preview, a comet station's or sandworm nest's peek now slides the preview down when that makes room to show its next comets or sandworms.
notes.plain: Over a route preview, a station's or bus stop's pop-up now slides the preview down when that makes room to show its next trains or buses.

notes.scul: A comet station's or sandworm nest's peek now opens at full size the first time too, after you open the app and in flight, except right after a chart update.
notes.plain: A station's or bus stop's pop-up now opens at full size the first time too, after you open the app and on a ride, except right after a map update.

notes.scul: The comet station you stand at is now drawn by your ship, and a tap on it opens its peek.
notes.plain: The T station you are standing at is now drawn by your avatar, and a tap on it opens its pop-up.

notes.scul: Fresh chart data from November 12.
notes.plain: Fresh map data from November 12.

notes.scul: A comet station's or sandworm nest's peek no longer flashes as it opens: a time still on its way is a gray oval that fills in place, to pancake's design.
notes.plain: A station's or bus stop's pop-up no longer flashes as it opens: a time still on its way is a gray oval that fills in place, to pancake's design.

notes.scul: On a peek and in the course preview, every line's name is now white on its color, as on the T's signs, the Orange Line's too. Only sandworm yellow keeps black.
notes.plain: In a pop-up and the route preview, every line's name is now white on its color, as on the T's signs, the Orange Line's too. Only a bus's yellow keeps black.

notes.scul: A peek now names a kind without "a": "Tardis · Public toilet", "Coolant · Drinking water", "Temple of Knowledge · Library".
notes.plain: A place's kind is now named without "a", as a restaurant's already was: "Porter · Train or subway station", "Massachusetts Ave @ Walden St · Bus stop".

notes.scul: On Android, the header of the Log, Settings and their pages is now the color of the phone's status bar above it, by day and by night.
notes.plain: On Android, the header of the Log, Settings and their pages is now the color of the phone's status bar above it, by day and by night.

notes.scul: By comet's "Stairs at …" now shows only when your comet's platform can't be reached without stairs, so not for Oak Grove's Orange Line, which has elevators.
notes.plain: By train's "Stairs at …" now shows only when your train's platform can't be reached without stairs, so not for Oak Grove's Orange Line, which has elevators.

notes.scul: A change of comets now gets "Stairs at …" too where the ship must be carried on stairs between platforms, as at Oak Grove to or from the Haverhill Line.
notes.plain: A change of trains now gets "Stairs at …" too where the bike must be carried on stairs between platforms, as at Oak Grove to or from the Haverhill Line.

notes.scul: A flight to or from a comet at North Station, South Station or Ruggles now uses a door to that comet's platform, step-free where it can be.
notes.plain: A bike ride to or from a train at North Station, South Station or Ruggles now uses a door to that train's platform, step-free where it can be.

notes.scul: At those stations, a change between the Commuter Rail and the subway now counts the real walk with the ship, so a few courses take a later comet.
notes.plain: At those stations, a change between the Commuter Rail and the subway now counts the real walk with the bike, so a few routes take a later train.

notes.scul: On your course's comet, Starchart now knows you're aboard from how you move: you glide forward along the tracks, never back, with no "Missed" turns.
notes.plain: On your route's train, Starchart now knows you're aboard from how you move: you glide forward along the tracks, never back, with no "Missed" turns.

notes.scul: A space walk to or from a Commuter Rail comet at North or South Station now uses the train station's own door. A course's comets are drawn on their tracks.
notes.plain: A walk to or from a Commuter Rail train at North Station or South Station now uses the train station's own door. A route's trains are drawn on their tracks.

notes.scul: Every sandworm nest is its own icon again, with its own peek, and all nests in view appear together as you zoom in. The Icon legend has every icon in search.
notes.plain: Every bus stop is its own icon again, with its own pop-up, and all stops in view appear together as you zoom in. The Icon legend has every icon in search.

notes.scul: While Starchart plots a course, the course preview shows "Plotting course…" beside Cancel, which no longer jumps. Launch appears once there's a course.
notes.plain: While Starchart finds a route, the route preview shows "Finding route…" beside Cancel, which no longer jumps. Start appears once there's a route.

notes.scul: Smaller things: no Settings flash between tabs, no "Finding your position…" at every start, a black status bar in Pocket droid and a bright green default ship.
notes.plain: Smaller things: no flash of Settings between tabs, no "Finding your position…" at every start, a black status bar in Pocket and a brighter green for the avatar.

notes.scul: A bus is now a sandworm in Trade-offs and on a space walk, in its rows and on board. The Silver Line and airport shuttles read as on a peek: "Silver Line SL1".
notes.plain: Plans now name the Silver Line and airport shuttles as a stop's pop-up does: "Silver Line SL1" and "Shuttle 22", not "Bus SL1" and "Bus 22".

notes.scul: A comet station's or sandworm nest's peek now groups its departures by line, to pancake's design: a strip in the line's color, then a row for each direction.
notes.plain: A station's or bus stop's pop-up now groups its departures by line, to pancake's design: a strip in the line's color, then a row for each direction.

notes.scul: Times are live unless marked: a gray time with a small clock is from the timetable. A bike after a time means that comet or sandworm takes bikes.
notes.plain: Times are live unless marked: a gray time with a small clock is from the timetable. A bike after a time means that train or bus takes bikes.

notes.scul: The Silver Line is now on the peeks of Airport, Chelsea and South Station (the subway one). Airport's also lists Massport's shuttles.
notes.plain: The Silver Line is now on the pop-ups of Airport, Chelsea and South Station (the subway one). Airport's also lists Massport's shuttles.

notes.scul: The peek now stays open until you close it with its × or a tap on the chart. A long list scrolls inside it, and track numbers are gone.
notes.plain: The pop-up now stays open until you close it with its × or a tap on the map. A long list scrolls inside it, and track numbers are gone.

notes.scul: A comet station's icon is no longer hidden by a name: a system or quadrant name moves aside. Where two stations can't both fit, the one with more lines shows.
notes.plain: A T station's icon is no longer hidden by a name: a town's or neighborhood's name moves aside. Where two stations can't both fit, the one with more lines shows.

notes.scul: Where to? finds a pasted address with its state, ZIP or apartment number, J.P. Licks typed "jp licks" and the CVS at Porter Constellation typed "cvs porter".
notes.plain: Where to? finds a pasted address with its state, ZIP or apartment number, J.P. Licks typed "jp licks" and the CVS at Porter Square typed "cvs porter".

notes.scul: Where to? finds the nearest comet station for "t stop" and Downtown Crossing for "dtx".
notes.plain: Where to? finds the nearest T station for "t stop" and Downtown Crossing for "dtx".

notes.scul: Near the landing pad the card no longer says 0.0 LY, and on a space walk its list of turns ahead says miles, as the card does.
notes.plain: Near a route's end the card no longer says 0.0 mi, and a street you go to keeps its full name on the card, in the Log and a share: To Massachusetts Avenue.

notes.scul: With large text the radar's times and the Log's months no longer run together, and a number stays with its unit. A screen reader skips Settings' arrows.
notes.plain: With large text the rain radar's times and the Log's months no longer run together, and a number stays with its unit. A screen reader skips Settings' arrows.

notes.scul: Along the way's Coolant, Tardis and Refueling now show with their numbers, no longer widening a moment later. Starpath preferences' dates read "since Nov 11".
notes.plain: Along the way's Water, Toilets and Groceries now show with their numbers, no longer widening a moment later. Street preferences' dates read "since Nov 11".

notes.scul: Search now knows Boston's and Cambridge's quadrants: "cvs jamaica plain" and "dunkin southie" find the ones there.
notes.plain: Search now knows Boston's and Cambridge's neighborhoods: "cvs jamaica plain" and "dunkin southie" find the ones there.

notes.scul: On a space walk with a comet, the LIVE time is now always a comet that stops where you get off, never one bound for the line's other branch.
notes.plain: On a walk with a train, the LIVE time is now always a train that stops where you get off, never one bound for the line's other branch.

notes.scul: On a space walk, a Blue Line comet then another comet or a sandworm now shows one $2.40 fare, not $4.80 or $4.10.
notes.plain: On a walk, a Blue Line train then another train or a bus now shows one $2.40 fare, not $4.80 or $4.10.

notes.scul: With Pocket droid on, Starchart no longer downloads the chart's comets, and the buzz one stop before yours now follows your comet's live time, as without it.
notes.plain: In Pocket, Starchart no longer downloads the map's trains, and the buzz one stop before yours now follows your train's live time, as it does outside Pocket.

notes.scul: On a sandworm, the app no longer thinks you got off a stop early, and the stops to go count down one at a time.
notes.plain: On a bus, the app no longer thinks you got off a stop early, and the stops to go count down one at a time.

notes.scul: After the app restarts mid-flight, the minutes left and arrival time are right again.
notes.plain: After the app restarts in the middle of a ride, the minutes left and arrival time are right again.

notes.scul: A voice download cut off by a lost signal now picks up again by itself when the signal is back.
notes.plain: A voice download cut off by a lost signal now picks up again by itself when the signal is back.

notes.scul: If the chart went blank as you turned your droid, it could stay blank until the app restarted. Now it comes back by itself.
notes.plain: If the map went blank as you turned the screen, it could stay blank until the app restarted. Now it comes back by itself.

notes.scul: The Where to? bar, the course you pick, the turn card, the turn pictures and the pins are now green, not Plain's purple. Other courses on the chart are gray.
notes.plain: SCUL mode's bars, cards, pins and turn pictures are now green, where they shared the purple you see here. With SCUL mode off, nothing changes.

notes.scul: By night SCUL's labels, thin lines, the Log's climb bars and Pocket droid's ring are neutral gray, no longer lavender.
notes.plain: By night SCUL mode's labels, thin lines and the Log's climb bars are neutral gray, as they are here, no longer lavender.

notes.scul: A sandworm nest is now pancake's yellow bus stop sign, with a black worm in place of the bus.
notes.plain: In SCUL mode a bus stop now wears pancake's yellow sign, as here, with a black worm in place of the bus.

notes.scul: A place's peek is now its name over three buttons: a star, a link to copy and an arrow to set a course. No more distance or OpenStreetMap link.
notes.plain: A place's pop-up is now its name over three buttons: a star for favorites, a link to copy and an arrow for directions. No more distance or OpenStreetMap link.

notes.scul: Holding a place's icon or name on the chart now sets a course to that place, not to a waypoint. Anywhere else, a hold still drops a waypoint.
notes.plain: Holding a place's icon or name on the map now gets directions to that place, not to a pin. Anywhere else, a hold still drops a pin.

notes.scul: The Lanes layer now draws two kinds of line, in one shade: solid where protected, dashed where painted, one for each side with a lane. No sharrows.
notes.plain: The Bike lanes layer now draws two kinds of line, in one shade: solid where protected, dashed where painted, one for each side with a lane. No sharrows.

notes.scul: Zoomed in, North Station, South Station and Braintree (with its chart pack) are now two comet stations each, subway and commuter rail, each at its own place.
notes.plain: Zoomed in, North Station, South Station and Braintree (with its map pack) are now two stations each, subway and commuter rail, each at its own place.

notes.scul: Fresh chart data from November 11.
notes.plain: Fresh map data from November 11.

notes.scul: By ship, the course you pick shows its elevation in its row, coloured by how good the flying is, to pancake's design. Other courses are thin bars; no timeline.
notes.plain: By bike, the route you pick shows its elevation in its row, coloured by how good the riding is, to pancake's design. Other routes are thin bars; no timeline.

notes.scul: The course preview's More has no Turn list. To add a stop, tap a place that Along the way shows on the chart. The Wormholes course is now Ship-friendly.
notes.plain: The route preview's More has no Turn list. To add a stop, tap a place that Along the way shows on the map. The Bike paths route is now Bike-friendly.

notes.scul: Swiping the course preview down no longer cancels it: it shrinks to one line and your course stays on the chart. Tap the line to bring it back.
notes.plain: Swiping the route preview down no longer cancels it: it shrinks to one line and your route stays on the map. Tap the line to bring it back.

notes.scul: Sandworm nests facing each other split in two as soon as there's room, sliding apart as you zoom in. Zoomed in close, starpath names no longer cover them.
notes.plain: Bus stops facing each other split in two as soon as there's room, sliding apart as you zoom in. Zoomed in close, street names no longer cover bus stops.

notes.scul: A space walk now looks the same from your first step: footprints when zoomed in, dots when zoomed out. No more dots before the footprints.
notes.plain: A walk now looks the same from your first step: footprints when zoomed in, dots when zoomed out. No more dots before the footprints.

notes.scul: A starred place called Space Station or Home is an ordinary star now, and Burn up always goes to the Fort. From and To list starred places first as you type.
notes.plain: Home is an ordinary favorite now, with no house and no Head home. The name you gave a favorite shows on its route, and From and To list favorites first.

notes.scul: Two turns in a row are one picture on the turn card, a black hole is drawn with its real starpaths and the landing pad shows the chart's pin.
notes.plain: On the turn card two turns in a row are one picture, a rotary shows its real roads and arriving shows the pin. Slight turns say "Keep left" or "Keep right".

notes.scul: Pocket droid's slide is longer and starts lower, with no full-screen notice. In flight the round buttons sit under the turn card, in one stack in landscape.
notes.plain: Pocket's slide is longer and starts lower, with no full-screen notice. On a ride the round buttons sit right under the turn card, in one stack in landscape.

notes.scul: The Log and Settings share a header that stays put, the tab bar has dividers and a press shades the whole item. Every small bike is the Bluebikes sign's bike.
notes.plain: The Log and Settings share a header that stays put, the tab bar has dividers and a press shades the whole item. Every small bike is the Bluebikes sign's bike.

notes.scul: Radiation that Weather reports is now always drawn on the chart. Loading shows the honeycomb alone.
notes.plain: Rain that Weather reports is now always drawn on the map. A ride starts with a short blip and ends with a short swoop. Loading shows the honeycomb alone.

notes.scul: The course preview has a new look, to pancake's design: each way is a row under one timeline, its bar running from when you leave to when you arrive.
notes.plain: The route preview has a new look, to pancake's design: each way is a row under one timeline, its bar running from when you leave to when you arrive.

notes.scul: In the bars a space walk is now grey, a wait hatched and the time before you leave an empty box. Comets and sandworms keep their lines' colours.
notes.plain: In the bars a walk is now grey, a wait hatched and the time before you leave an empty box. Trains and buses keep their lines' colours.

notes.scul: A row with a comet or sandworm says when to leave: "leave now" or "leave in 13 min by 8:49". Its minutes start when you leave.
notes.plain: A row with a train or bus says when to leave: "leave now" or "leave in 13 min by 8:49". Its minutes start when you leave.

notes.scul: Tap a row to pick it; its details show below. With the course preview open the rows keep time, and Starchart plots again once a comet or sandworm is missed.
notes.plain: Tap a row to pick it; its details show below. With the route preview open the rows keep time, and Starchart plans again once a train or bus is missed.

notes.scul: Cancel at the bottom now closes the course preview, in place of its ×. Arrive by is under More, no longer a tap on the ride time.
notes.plain: Cancel at the bottom now closes the route preview, in place of its ×. Arrive by is under More, no longer a tap on the ride time.

notes.scul: Your Space Station is now the starred place you call Space Station or Home. It shows a space station. Rename or remove it in Settings › Charts › Starred places.
notes.plain: Home is now the favorite you name Home, marked with a house. Rename or remove it in Settings › Maps › Favorites. If you had set a home, it's there.

notes.scul: The Space Station button beside To is gone, so a stray tap can't set it. To set it, star a place, tap Call sign and name it Space Station.
notes.plain: The house button beside To is gone, so a stray tap can't set home. To set it, star a place, tap Nickname and name it Home.

notes.scul: On a course by comet or sandworm, the card and the pin show your landing pad, not a station on the way. The readout shows the whole course's arrival.
notes.plain: On a route by train or bus, the card and the pin show where you're going, not a station on the way. The readout shows the whole route's arrival.

notes.scul: The whole course stays on the chart, each comet or sandworm in its line's colour. Nearing a comet station: "Comet station ahead", not "Landing pad ahead".
notes.plain: The whole route stays on the map, each train or bus in its line's colour. Nearing a station, you hear "Station ahead", not "Destination ahead".

notes.scul: On a course by comet, your pilot follows the line underground by the timetable instead of waiting at the station entrance.
notes.plain: On a route by train, your avatar follows the line underground by the timetable instead of waiting at the station entrance.

notes.scul: With SCUL mode off, bus stops and Bluebikes stations wear new round signs by pancake. Sandworm nests and Klingon docks stay as they are.
notes.plain: New bus stop and Bluebikes signs by pancake: a round yellow sign with the MBTA's bus, and a round cyan one with a bike.

notes.scul: Sandworm nests facing each other across a starpath show as one icon until you zoom in close. Tap it for one peek with both sides' sandworms, by direction.
notes.plain: Bus stops facing each other across a street show as one icon until you zoom in close. Tap it for one pop-up with both sides' buses, grouped by direction.

notes.scul: On a course by sandworm or to a nest, both sides of its nests show at every zoom: yours bright, each saying where its sandworms go ("to Harvard").
notes.plain: On a route by bus or to a bus stop, both sides of its stops show at every zoom: yours bright, each saying where its buses go ("to Harvard").

notes.scul: Fresh chart data from November 10.
notes.plain: Fresh map data from November 10.

notes.scul: On a space walk, a crossing now says "Cross Starpath Cambridge", not two turns. Either side of the starpath is on course. Your pilot points the way you walk.
notes.plain: On a walk, a crossing now says "Cross Cambridge Street", not two turns. Either side of the street is on route. Your avatar points the way you walk.

notes.scul: A space walk or flight ends by itself on arrival, indoors too. At Trade-offs' Space walk end, a comet or bus shows only if 5 min quicker, except in radiation.
notes.plain: A walk or ride ends by itself on arrival, indoors too. At Trade-offs' Walking end, a train or bus shows only if it's 5 min quicker, except in bad weather.

notes.scul: When a flight takes a comet, Starchart now follows you on board and counts the stops, as on a space walk. The "No GPS underground" notice is gone.
notes.plain: When a bike ride takes the T, Starchart now follows you on board and counts the stops, as on a walk. The "No GPS underground" notice is gone.

notes.scul: Pocket droid unlocks with one slide up, no hold first. Back from another app, your flight shows at once. The card says "then port" only for back-to-back turns.
notes.plain: Pocket unlocks with one slide up, no hold first. Back from another app, your ride shows at once. The card says "then left" only for back-to-back turns.

notes.scul: The Log has a "Select multiple" button. Starred places and Starpath preferences moved to Settings › Charts. One yellow everywhere, a softer star edge by day.
notes.plain: The Log has a "Select multiple" button. Favorites and Street preferences moved to Settings › Maps. One yellow everywhere, with a softer star edge by day.

notes.scul: In flight, Pocket droid is a round button at the top of the column and Long haul is gone. To show the chart again, rest a finger on the ring and slide it up.
notes.plain: In a ride, Pocket is a round button at the top of the column and Dim screen is gone. To show the map again, rest a finger on the ring and slide it up.

notes.scul: Walking all the way is offered up to 2 LY (4 LY leaning to Space walk), in radiation too. Pace is now Flight pace, and Space walk pace shows once you start one.
notes.plain: Walking all the way is offered up to 2 mi (4 mi leaning to Walking), in the rain too. Pace is now Biking pace, and Walking pace shows once you start a walk.

notes.scul: On a space walk, Starchart follows you onto the comet or bus and counts the stops, even with no GPS underground. A station's peek says when a line is suspended.
notes.plain: On a walk, Starchart follows you onto the train or bus and counts the stops, even with no GPS underground. A station's pop-up says when a line is suspended.

notes.scul: Starpaths are lighter by day and darker by night, so names stand out. Radiation is drawn as marks alone, with no grey shading, in flight too.
notes.plain: Streets are lighter by day and darker by night, so names stand out. Rain shows only as drops, dashes and streaks, with no grey shading, during a ride too.

notes.scul: The Log's Select shows checkboxes. Trade-offs says more about each choice. Screens no longer flash when you move between Settings, the Log and their pages.
notes.plain: The Log's Select shows checkboxes. Trade-offs says more about each choice. Screens no longer flash when you move between Settings, the Log and their pages.

notes.scul: Settings no longer loses Offline charts or Send feedback when opened while Starchart starts. In the feedback box, a droid's Enter key makes a new line again.
notes.plain: Settings no longer loses Offline maps or Send feedback when opened while Starchart starts. In the feedback box, a phone's Enter key makes a new line again.

notes.scul: When GPS drops in flight, a chip says "Flying blind" and counts the time. Your pilot no longer fades.
notes.plain: When the GPS signal drops during a ride, a chip says "No GPS signal" and counts the time. Your avatar no longer fades.

notes.scul: The update note now closes with a swipe, a tap on it or Back. Layers and Weather close on a tap on the chart and stay open while you drag or pinch.
notes.plain: The update note now closes with a swipe, a tap on it or Back. Layers and Weather close on a tap on the map and stay open while you drag or pinch.

notes.scul: Starred places: the pen sets a call sign and its box stays above the keyboard. Where to? lists the most recently used first. Settings says how many.
notes.plain: Favorites: the pen sets a nickname and its box stays above the keyboard. Where to? lists the most recently used first. Settings says how many.

notes.scul: Comet station signs are as tall as other icons and search shows each station's line colours. Coolant that may be off for winter wears a big X.
notes.plain: Bus stops show a yellow bus sign, T signs are taller and search shows each station's line colours. Water fountains that may be off for winter wear a big X.

notes.scul: Detailed names the starpath you turn onto: "Turn to port onto Starpath Elm." The names come by themselves on Wi-Fi, or from Settings › Offline charts.
notes.plain: Detailed directions name the street you turn onto: "Turn left onto Elm Street." The names come by themselves on Wi-Fi, or from Settings › Offline maps.

notes.scul: On Android, Starchart asks before a big download while the droid's on mobile data. Tap On Wi-Fi and it waits, then starts by itself on Wi-Fi.
notes.plain: On Android, Starchart asks before a big download on mobile data. Tap On Wi-Fi and it waits, then starts by itself once you're on Wi-Fi.

notes.scul: Detailed says Quincy, Peabody and Faneuil as Boston does, and Critter says every starpath name a little slower.
notes.plain: Detailed says Quincy, Peabody and Faneuil as Boston does, and Critter says every street name a little slower.

notes.scul: From November to April, coolant that may be off for the winter has a snowflake and isn't suggested along a course.
notes.plain: From November to April, water fountains that may be off for the winter have a snowflake and aren't suggested along a route.

notes.scul: On Android, Sound is one setting: Off, Buzz only, Basic or Detailed. Basic and Detailed speak the turns; Buzz only buzzes them and points you to Pocket droid.
notes.plain: On Android, Sound is one setting: Off, Buzz only, Basic or Detailed. Basic and Detailed speak the turns; Buzz only buzzes them and points you to Pocket.

notes.scul: Back from a screen-off stretch in flight, Starchart says how long you flew dark and why, with a Pocket droid button. Pocket droid now fills the whole screen.
notes.plain: Back from a screen-off stretch in a ride, Starchart says how long wasn't tracked and why, with a Pocket button. Pocket now fills the whole screen.

notes.scul: Comet station signs are smaller, with a thinner coloured ring, and overlap at a station with several lines. Names are tightly spaced and never see-through.
notes.plain: T station signs are smaller, with a thinner coloured ring, and overlap at a station with several lines. Names are tightly spaced and never see-through.

notes.scul: Give a starred place a call sign, such as Home or Work: tap Call sign as you star it, or the tag in Settings › Starred places. Search finds it.
notes.plain: Give a favorite a nickname, such as Home or Work: tap Nickname as you star it, or the tag in Settings › Favorites. Search finds it by that name.

notes.scul: Radiation on the chart is lighter: fewer, finer marks, so the starpaths and names show through.
notes.plain: Rain on the map is lighter: fewer, finer drops, so the streets and names show through.

notes.scul: Names on the chart read better by day and by night, with no grey writing. Sandworm nests show from closer in and pharmacy Lunas are orange again.
notes.plain: Names on the map read better by day and by night, with no grey writing. Bus stops show from closer in and pharmacies are orange again.

notes.scul: Trade-offs has By ship and On foot tabs, each with its own radiation choice. Space walks now favor fewer changes, and On foot can lean to them more.
notes.plain: Trade-offs has By bike and On foot tabs, each with its own bad-weather choice. Walks now favor fewer changes, and On foot can lean to them more.

notes.scul: Space walks have Leave at and Arrive by, and cards show times first, then the fare. Consider Klingon docks adds a Bluebike, with live bike and dock counts.
notes.plain: Walks have Leave at and Arrive by, and cards show times first, then the fare. Consider Bluebikes in Settings adds a Bluebike, with live bike and dock counts.

notes.scul: The chart fills in faster as you pan and zoom. The course preview zooms to fit as its panel opens and closes, and the panel drags from anywhere.
notes.plain: The map fills in faster as you pan and zoom. The route preview zooms to fit as its panel opens and closes, and the panel drags from anywhere.

notes.scul: Fewer peeks. "Landing pad ahead, to port" has no pause now, and coolant known to be shut for winter is hidden.
notes.plain: Fewer pop-ups and simpler sounds with no echo. "Destination ahead, on the left" has no pause now. Water fountains known to be shut for winter are hidden.

notes.scul: A new app icon by pancake: an S-shaped starpath from red to cyan.
notes.plain: A new app icon by pancake: an S-shaped road from red to cyan.

notes.scul: Other courses show in purple, your course has a white border in flight and the arrows along it are gone. Detailed says when you turn onto a one-way starpath.
notes.plain: Other routes show in purple, your route has a white border while you ride and the arrows along it are gone. Detailed says when you turn onto a one-way street.

notes.scul: Radiation warnings say when it starts, how heavy it is and how long it lasts. Trade-offs can lean to comets and buses or a radiation suit.
notes.plain: Rain warnings say when it starts, how heavy it is and how long it lasts. Trade-offs can lean to the T and bus or to rain gear in bad weather.

notes.scul: Panels and peeks swipe away, and Launch starts a new flight while Undo still shows. Past the chart's edge, Starchart offers that area's chart pack.
notes.plain: Panels and pop-ups swipe away, and Record starts a new ride while Undo still shows. Past the map's edge, Starchart offers that area's map pack.

notes.scul: Space walks have Along the way as courses do. Coolant icons no longer fade in winter and the Log's replay flies your own pilot.
notes.plain: Walks list water, toilets and groceries along the way. Water icons no longer fade in winter and the Log's replay shows your own avatar.

notes.scul: A course through Boston Common, Harvard Yard or another park that bans riding says Walk your ship through it, timed at walking pace. Ships go round cemeteries.
notes.plain: A route through Boston Common, Harvard Yard or another park that bans riding says Walk your bike through it, timed at walking pace. Bikes go round cemeteries.

notes.scul: Your Pace speeds up the flying only: a space walk keeps walking pace, so a course with one is timed right.
notes.plain: Your Pace speeds up the riding only: walking keeps walking pace, so a route with a walk in it is timed right.

notes.scul: Comets that cross keep apart, their heads above every tail.
notes.plain: Trains show as a head with no tail, and two that cross keep apart.

notes.scul: Rain's drops show how hard it rains: round drops for light rain, dashes for moderate, long streaks for heavy.
notes.plain: Rain's drops show how hard it rains: round drops for light rain, dashes for moderate, long streaks for heavy.

notes.scul: Your ship stays solid on a computer too.
notes.plain: Your avatar stays solid on a computer, the app says device where it said phone, and Consider trains in routing shows the T.

notes.scul: A comet station's picture shows every line that stops there: Porter and JFK/UMass the Red Line and the Commuter Rail, North Station all three of its lines.
notes.plain: A station's picture shows every line that stops there: Porter and JFK/UMass the Red Line and the Commuter Rail, North Station all three of its lines.

notes.scul: On a space walk, a comet or bus shows only when someone might really take it, so no bus for one stop beside a short walk. The weather tips the balance.
notes.plain: On foot, a train or bus shows only when someone might really take it, so no bus for one stop beside a short walk. The weather tips the balance.

notes.scul: Settings › Routing › Trade-offs leans your courses towards wormholes, fewer negi g-wells or less space walk. Balanced plans as before.
notes.plain: Settings › Routing › Trade-offs leans your routes towards bike paths, fewer hills or less walking. Balanced plans as before.

notes.scul: Fresh chart data from November 1, with newly mapped bike racks along Mass Ave in Cambridge.
notes.plain: Fresh map data from November 1, with newly mapped bike racks along Mass Ave in Cambridge.

notes.scul: Where to? and Launch are one bar at the top: tap its left for a destination, its right end to fly without a course.
notes.plain: Where to? and Record are one bar at the top: tap its left to pick a destination, its right end to just record a ride.

notes.scul: Taking a bus? Yours shows live on the chart with its minutes to your stop. Comets show which way they're heading, and station icons take a tap.
notes.plain: Taking a bus? Yours shows live on the map with its minutes to your stop. Trains show which way they're heading, and station icons take a tap.

notes.scul: The voice says "walk your bike" where you must, names the bike lane you turn onto, calls pulsars nearer and no longer names bus stops or neighbourhoods.
notes.plain: The voice says "walk your bike" where you must, names the bike lane you turn onto, calls traffic lights nearer and no longer names bus stops or neighbourhoods.

notes.scul: One icon style on the chart: pharmacies and urgent care in red, place names in their icon's colour, one water colour and lighter Daystar streets.
notes.plain: One icon style on the map: pharmacies and urgent care in red, place names in their icon's colour, one water colour and lighter streets in Light.

notes.scul: Course cards show when you'd land, and SCUL mode is a switch in Settings, with each mode keeping its own avatar and voice.
notes.plain: Route cards show when you'd arrive, and SCUL mode is a switch in Settings, with each mode keeping its own avatar and voice.

notes.scul: Pocket droid: from Long haul, the screen goes black and ignores every touch while the flight, the voice and the buzzes go on; hold the ring to come back.
notes.plain: Pocket: from Dim screen, the screen goes black and ignores every touch while the ride, the voice and the buzzes go on; hold the ring to come back.

notes.scul: The loading honeycomb takes the theme's colour in Plain, and About lists Send feedback's host with the others.
notes.plain: The loading honeycomb is purple like the rest of the app, and About lists Send feedback's host with the others.

notes.scul: Search puts Logan International Airport first for "logan", and no longer lists a skybridge's address as a starpath ("Terminal B").
notes.plain: Search puts Logan International Airport first for "logan", and no longer lists a skybridge's address as a street ("Terminal B").

notes.scul: Search finds parks an address had hidden: Medford's The Green, Winthrop Square, Science Park, Shipyard Park and Metcalf Square.
notes.plain: Search finds parks an address had hidden: Medford's The Green, Winthrop Square, Science Park, Shipyard Park and Metcalf Square.

notes.scul: Logan and its terminals are in search, and Silver Line and airport shuttle stops show their next sandworms (shuttle times: Massport).
notes.plain: Logan and its terminals are in search, and Silver Line and airport shuttle stops show their next buses (shuttle times: Massport).

notes.scul: Sandworm times wear the MBTA's bus yellow, the Silver Line grey and the shuttles blue; free places are round, paid places square.
notes.plain: Bus times wear the MBTA's bus yellow, the Silver Line grey and the shuttles blue; free places are round, paid places square.

notes.scul: Dark's starpaths are one solid grey, bike racks give way to other icons, and buildings fade in as you zoom.
notes.plain: Terrain starts off, Dark's streets are one solid grey, bike racks give way to other icons, and buildings fade in as you zoom.

notes.scul: The Log has Overview and All flights sections, and the Settings tab returns where you were, with a second tap to its top.
notes.plain: The Arrow is the first avatar, the Log has Overview and All rides sections, and the Settings tab returns where you were.

notes.scul: About lists the hosts Starchart talks to, Words sits above Avatar, and Never's sign is a crisp X.
notes.plain: About lists the hosts Starchart talks to, Words sits above Avatar, and Never's sign is a crisp X.

notes.scul: Search knows famous places from a few letters ("faneu" for Faneuil Hall), lists each place once, and shows its house number.
notes.plain: Search knows famous places from a few letters ("faneu" for Faneuil Hall), lists each place once, and shows its house number.

notes.scul: Switching Words recolours the chart's avoided streets and unpaved stretches at once.
notes.plain: Switching Words recolours the map's avoided streets and unpaved stretches at once.

notes.scul: A space walk resumed after a reload shows the walker and keeps its course.
notes.plain: A walk resumed after a reload shows the walker and keeps its route.

notes.scul: First-time tips wait while Layers or Weather is open, and Send feedback names the panel you had open and the voice you hear.
notes.plain: First-time tips wait while Layers or Weather is open, and Send feedback names the panel you had open and the voice you hear.

notes.scul: A change to the droid's reduced motion reaches every animation at once, and if the chart's style fails to load, picking a theme tries again.
notes.plain: A change to the device's reduced motion reaches every animation at once, and if the map's style fails to load, picking a theme tries again.

notes.scul: A course card's comet or sandworm leg lists its next three departures, and says Leave by when you'd reach the stop early.
notes.plain: A route card's train or bus leg lists its next three departures, and says Leave by when you'd reach the stop early.

notes.scul: Tap a Sandworm Nest for its next sandworms by route, from the timetable on your droid, live where the MBTA predicts.
notes.plain: Tap a bus stop for its next buses by route, from the timetable on your device, live where the MBTA predicts.

notes.scul: New chart colours: the course and its pins in purple, paid places as orange squares. SCUL keeps its green and its glow.
notes.plain: A new look in Plain: your route and its pins in purple, paid places as orange squares, and flat buttons with no glow.

notes.scul: Place names are bold, in ink, beside their icons, and a flight shows a few names along the course ahead.
notes.plain: Place names are bold, in ink, beside their icons, and a ride shows a few names along the route ahead.

notes.scul: Chart data from October 28: no gas station's air shows as a bike pump, and corner search works in chart packs.
notes.plain: Map data from October 28: no gas station's air shows as a bike pump, and corner search works in map packs.

notes.scul: Back up all flights has an arrow and asks on a solid card, and T stations' rings run to the edge in the line's colour.
notes.plain: Back up all rides has an arrow and asks on a solid card, and T stations' rings run to the edge in the line's colour.

notes.scul: With Buttons left, the buttons stay on the left on every screen, the course preview too, and in landscape the side panels sit on the right.
notes.plain: With Buttons left, the buttons stay on the left on every screen, the route preview too, and in landscape the side panels sit on the right.

notes.scul: With Buttons left, the scale stays put after a flight, and Overview frames the course in landscape.
notes.plain: With Buttons left, the scale stays put after a ride, and Overview frames the route in landscape.

notes.scul: The course line and Ship-friendly starpaths now rate each street the same way, so their colours agree.
notes.plain: The route line and Bike-friendly roads now rate each street the same way, so their colours agree.

notes.scul: Search lists footbridges as Hyper-Wormholes, and Vibrate at turns says what works: Droid on Vibrate, not Silent.
notes.plain: Search lists footbridges as footbridges, and Vibrate at turns says what works: Phone on Vibrate, not Silent.

notes.scul: Search finds a place from its first letters ("minut" for the Minuteman, "fresh p" for Fresh Pond), a corner typed with a slash, and "farm" Pemberton Farms.
notes.plain: Search finds a place from its first letters ("minut" for the Minuteman, "fresh p" for Fresh Pond), a corner typed with a slash, and "farm" Pemberton Farms.

notes.scul: A corner of a road with a frontage road shows once, and a kind's words half typed ("bike sh", "post o") list that kind.
notes.plain: A corner of a road with a frontage road shows once, and a kind's words half typed ("bike sh", "post o") list that kind.

notes.scul: The lightbulb button is gone from the chart: the theme is set in Settings, under Theme.
notes.plain: The lightbulb button is gone from the map: the theme is set in Settings, under Theme.

notes.scul: Search finds street corners: type "mass ave and prospect st", "comm ave & harvard ave" or "beacon at park".
notes.plain: Search finds street corners: type "mass ave and prospect st", "comm ave & harvard ave" or "beacon at park".

notes.scul: A wormhole or a river found by search is measured and plotted to its nearest point, and "wormhole" or "grocery" lists the nearest ones first.
notes.plain: A bike path or a river found by search is measured and routed to its nearest point, and "bike path" or "grocery" lists the nearest first.

notes.scul: Search rows show a supermarket's cart, a bakery's and a pharmacy's icons, as the chart draws them.
notes.plain: Search rows show a supermarket's cart, a bakery's and a pharmacy's icons, as the map draws them.

notes.scul: Sound steps Off, Basic and Detailed with one tap, a lightbulb button switches day and night, and the round buttons keep their places in a flight.
notes.plain: Sound steps Off, Basic and Detailed with one tap, a lightbulb button switches day and night, and the round buttons keep their places in a ride.

notes.scul: On a course the chart shows only its own pulsars and stop signs, none while browsing, and all-way stops get their own sign and words.
notes.plain: On a route the map shows only its own traffic lights and stop signs, none while browsing, and all-way stops get their own sign and words.

notes.scul: T lines are one line until you zoom in, then tracks with closer ties, and station names wait for street zoom.
notes.plain: T lines are one line until you zoom in, then tracks with closer ties; station names wait for street zoom, and 3D draws no T underground.

notes.scul: Rain on the weather layer is drawn as dashes you can see, and traffic cones take the course's orange.
notes.plain: Rain is drawn as dashes you can see, cones take the route's orange, Robot speaks with Lodestar's voice, and Warm is now Classic.

notes.scul: Bigger tab names with the whole tab shaded, and Send is ready again at once with a Sent! bubble.
notes.plain: Bigger tab names with the whole tab shaded, and Send is ready again at once with a Sent! bubble.

notes.scul: Search finds a place by its address (21 Nichols Ave is La Bodega) and its other names; an exact name comes first: the Prudential Center before its plazas.
notes.plain: Search finds a place by its address (21 Nichols Ave is La Bodega) and its other names; an exact name comes first: the Prudential Center before its plazas.

notes.scul: Search reads local short names (JP, Southie, the Pru, Comm Ave), forgives small typos, and weighs nearness before the kind of place.
notes.plain: Search reads local short names (JP, Southie, the Pru, Comm Ave), forgives small typos, and weighs nearness before the kind of place.

notes.scul: Search rows show whole names, one shape of second line and the map's own icons for places, and search is ready sooner after the first start.
notes.plain: Search rows show whole names, one shape of second line and the map's own icons for places, and search is ready sooner after the first start.

notes.scul: Search finds the places the chart draws from building outlines, like La Bodega in Watertown, Star Market and the Hynes, and named fields and greens.
notes.plain: Search finds the places the map draws from building outlines, like La Bodega in Watertown, Star Market and the Hynes, and named fields and greens.

notes.scul: Land ends the course and the flight together, with its Undo right in the bar; on a course the chart fades the stretch you've flown instead of your trail.
notes.plain: End stops the route and the recording together, with Undo right in the bar; on a route the map fades the part you've ridden instead of your GPS trail.

notes.scul: One colour scale on courses, their cards and Ship-friendly starpaths: blue for lanes and wormholes, then green through red, with red kept for the worst.
notes.plain: One colour scale on routes, their cards and Bike-friendly roads: blue for bike lanes and paths, then green through red, with red kept for the worst.

notes.scul: Drag a course preview up for arrive-by times, coolant and groceries along the way and the turns; slide a finger along its heights to find each spot.
notes.plain: Drag the route preview up for arrive-by times, water and groceries along the way and the turns; slide a finger along its heights to find each spot.

notes.scul: Comet stations in coloured rings with Comets off too, T lines as tracks, stop signs only on a course, plasma for bikes only, and rounded square shops.
notes.plain: Stations in coloured rings, rotaries as roundabout signs, T lines as tracks, stop signs only on a route, air pumps for bikes only, and rounded square shops.

notes.scul: Weather turns a radar sweep while it looks, the search chip names what it shows, and a station tap shows its trains even with Comets off.
notes.plain: Weather turns a radar sweep while it loads, the search chip names what it shows, and a station tap shows its trains even with Trains off.

notes.scul: Plain words take a new blue palette; SCUL keeps the club's green.
notes.plain: A new blue look: blue accents, pale blue highlights and a blue launch screen.

notes.scul: Place icons are a little larger, repair stands show with the other places as a wrench, construction is a traffic cone, and towns have a skyline.
notes.plain: Place icons are a little larger, repair stands show with the other places as a wrench, construction is a traffic cone, and towns have a skyline.

notes.scul: A comet station on two lines shows both roundels side by side in full colour, and the legend lists the starred star.
notes.plain: A T station on two lines shows both roundels side by side in full colour, and the legend lists the favourites star.

notes.scul: In a flight the bar spans the screen with Locate above it, and walking dots are as wide as a ride's line.
notes.plain: During a ride the bar spans the screen with Locate above it, and walking dots are as wide as a ride's line.

notes.scul: Settings' last part splits in three: App for what you do, About for what you read, and Developer tools on its own at the end.
notes.plain: Settings' last part splits in three: App for what you do, About for what you read, and Developer tools on its own at the end.

notes.scul: Starpath names on the chart are shorter (St, Ave, Sq) with the kind word easy to read at night, and on a course off-course stops and pulsars dim.
notes.plain: Street names on the map are shorter (St, Ave, Sq) with the kind word easy to read at night, and on a route the stop signs and lights off it dim.

notes.scul: Hospitals and first aid are medical red, the legend shows only what the chart draws, the starred star has a dark edge by day, and Locate stands out.
notes.plain: Hospitals and first aid are medical red, the legend shows only what the map draws, the favourites star has a dark edge by day, and Locate stands out.

notes.scul: Buzzes are long enough to feel, off course is unmistakable, and Settings says a phone on silent doesn't vibrate.
notes.plain: Buzzes are long enough to feel, off route is unmistakable, and Settings says a phone on silent doesn't vibrate.

notes.scul: Walks and flights draw their course alike, no message is cut short, and the welcome card's lines are simpler.
notes.plain: Walks and rides draw their route alike, no message is cut short, and the welcome card's lines are simpler.

notes.scul: The Offline chart row's new lines read cleanly in both word modes.
notes.plain: The Offline map row's new lines say map, as the rest of Plain words do.

notes.scul: Where a tab can't store the chart, as in Safari's Private Browsing, the Offline chart row says so and what to do instead of retrying in vain.
notes.plain: Where a tab can't store the map, as in Safari's Private Browsing, the Offline map row says so and what to do instead of retrying in vain.

notes.scul: A stalled chart download restarts when you come back to Starchart, and on an iPhone tab the row shows how to keep the chart on the home screen.
notes.plain: A stalled map download restarts when you come back to Starchart, and on an iPhone tab the row shows how to keep the map on the home screen.

notes.scul: Rough flying shows only the less bikeable starpaths, in yellow and red, bright by day. Wormholes and lanes stay in their own layer.
notes.plain: Stressful streets shows only the less bikeable streets, in yellow and red, bright by day. Bike lanes stay in their own layer.

notes.scul: A calmer chart: bright cyan lanes with no glow, drawn on the side of the starpath they're on, and no centre lines or transport tunnels.
notes.plain: A calmer map: bright cyan bike lanes with no glow, drawn on the side of the street they're on, and no centre lines or car tunnels.

notes.scul: Comet stations show at street level with Comets off, starpath names read clearly at night, and the Arrow is rounder and solid.
notes.plain: T stations show at street level with transit off, street names read clearly at night, and the Arrow is rounder and solid.

notes.scul: Back up all flights sits beside the Log's title, Back up and Restore ask first, Pace suggests in one line, and By the sun is the default.
notes.plain: Back up all rides sits beside the Log's title, Back up and Restore ask first, Pace suggests in one line, and By the sun is the default.

notes.scul: Robot sounds colder and metallic, route options switch quietly, Battery saver turns terrain off, and Send shows its progress.
notes.plain: Robot sounds colder and metallic, route options switch quietly, Battery saver turns terrain off, and Send shows its progress.

notes.scul: Places to pay are round pink icons with one white drawing, food is one fork and knife, and Klingon Docks are grey like sandworm nests.
notes.plain: Places to pay are round pink icons with one white drawing, food is one fork and knife, and Bluebikes docks are grey like bus stops.

notes.scul: Starred places wear a yellow star, pilot colours are bolder, and the Arrow is the Locate button's arrow.
notes.plain: Favourites wear a yellow star, avatar colours are bolder and red by default, and the Arrow is the Locate button's arrow.

notes.scul: Launch sits centred above the tabs. Layers, Weather and Sound move to the top, and the compass sits over Locate.
notes.plain: Record sits centred above the tabs. Layers, Weather and Sound move to the top, and the compass sits over Locate.

notes.scul: Detailed directions, now the default, name a pulsar, stop sign, sandworm nest or park at a turn.
notes.plain: Detailed directions, now the default, name a traffic light, stop sign, bus stop or park at a turn.

notes.scul: The heading beam stays narrow, and Vibrate at turns spells out its three buzzes.
notes.plain: The heading beam stays narrow, and Vibrate at turns spells out its three buzzes.

notes.scul: Search places an address OpenStreetMap lacks between its known neighbours, marked approximate, and a place not on the chart gets a link to add it.
notes.plain: Search places an address OpenStreetMap lacks between its known neighbours, marked approximate, and a place not on the map gets a link to add it.

notes.scul: Ride quality comes in a few clear colours: blue for bike lanes, none for average streets, then yellow, orange and red for worse ones.
notes.plain: Ride quality comes in a few clear colours: blue for bike lanes, none for average streets, then yellow, orange and red for worse ones.

notes.scul: A tapped bike lane's words read cleanly, Undo after Cancel keeps a course file's path, and Walk and T plans work in Safari's private tabs.
notes.plain: A tapped bike lane's words read cleanly, Undo after Cancel keeps a route file's path, and Walk and T plans work in Safari's private tabs.

notes.scul: Plain words get a Robot voice, a voice's preview plays alone and quietly, and Settings backs up and restores everything in one file.
notes.plain: Plain words get a Robot voice, a voice's preview plays alone and quietly, and Settings backs up and restores everything in one file.

notes.scul: The tab bar stays outside a flight and a pinch no longer zooms the page. The welcome card points to Settings, and Install is a round button in a browser tab.
notes.plain: The tab bar stays outside a ride and a pinch no longer zooms the page. The welcome card points to Settings, and Install is a round button in a browser tab.

notes.scul: Ride quality fills the street's full width in new colours, the course you pick stands out, and the ship's lamps suit the theme.
notes.plain: Ride quality fills the street's full width in new colours, the route you pick stands out, and the bike's lamps suit the theme.

notes.scul: With no GPS signal, Starchart shows the steps for your droid. The Log's All flights maps them all, and Pace moved to Settings.
notes.plain: With no GPS signal, Starchart shows the steps for your device. The Log's All rides maps them all, and Pace moved to Settings.

notes.scul: Bluebikes are pink and street names darker. Comet tails follow the tracks, shared stations show every line's colour, and the Arrow is a clean chevron.
notes.plain: Bluebikes are pink and street names darker. Train tails follow the tracks, shared stations show every line's colour, and the Arrow is a clean chevron.

notes.scul: The Log's box has Week, Month and Life. Life shows your next star class right there, and the flight count opens their map.
notes.plain: The Log's box has Week, Month and Life. Life shows your next milestone right there, and the ride count opens their map.

notes.scul: Comet tracks are one thick, see-through line per T line, with the comets riding on it and longer tails.
notes.plain: T lines are one thick, see-through line each, with the trains riding on it and longer tails.

notes.scul: Your pilot's colour paints the ship too. Locate says what it does, and Directions says what Detailed adds.
notes.plain: Your avatar's colour paints the bike too. Locate says what it does, and Directions says what Detailed adds.

notes.scul: Voices show their size, Vibrate at turns names the off-course buzzes, and large text fits small droids better.
notes.plain: Voices show their size, Vibrate at turns names the off-route buzzes, and large text fits small phones better.

notes.scul: Text follows your droid's text size, chart labels included. Big text grows gently, and the flight's numbers stay compact.
notes.plain: Text follows your device's text size, map labels included. Big text grows gently, and the ride's numbers stay compact.

notes: At large text sizes, From and To take the full width, long names wrap between words, and nothing slides off the screen.

notes.scul: A course's colours follow your direction: uphill on a busy starpath reads worse, downhill where you keep pace with transports reads fine.
notes.plain: A route's colours follow your direction: uphill on a busy street reads worse, downhill where you keep pace with cars reads fine.

notes.scul: Courses keep off busy starpaths whose bike lane runs the other way, and sharrows on busy starpaths count for less.
notes.plain: Routes keep off busy streets whose bike lane runs the other way, and sharrows on busy streets count for less.

notes.scul: A tap on a starpath shows just that starpath. On a bike route, tap Part of … to light the whole route.
notes.plain: A tap on a street shows just that street. On a bike route, tap Part of … to light the whole route.

notes.scul: Flying in Layers has a small ⓘ listing what the score reads. Shorter words across the app.
notes.plain: Ride quality in Layers has a small ⓘ listing what the score reads. Shorter words across the app, and the destination pin has no star.

notes.scul: Directions are Basic or Detailed now. A long starpath hears its turn again, Detailed adds “Still on course.”, and off course buzzes till you're back.
notes.plain: Directions are Basic or Detailed now. A long road hears its turn again, Detailed adds “Still on track.”, and going off the route buzzes till you're back.

notes.scul: Comet plans can take a sandworm with a bike rack when it's clearly quicker, and high-crash crossings are called out ahead.
notes.plain: Train trips can take a bus with a bike rack when it's clearly quicker, and high-crash crossings are called out ahead.

notes.scul: Burble is now Critter, saying every word. In plain words, SCUL's pictures get everyday icons, and every star has five points.
notes.plain: The Burble voice is now Critter, saying every word. Plain words get their own icons, like a police badge, and every star has five points.

notes.scul: Settings is a tab, with a short line under a row instead of info buttons. No Calm motion switch: motion calms when your droid asks, or with Battery saver.
notes.plain: Settings is a tab, with a short line under a row instead of info buttons. No Calm motion switch: motion calms when your device asks, or with Battery saver.

notes.scul: Tap a starpath to Prefer, Avoid or Never it. A course's preview is one clean line, and Daystar has one bike blue.
notes.plain: Tap a street to Prefer, Avoid or Never it. A route's preview is one clean line, and Light mode has one bike blue.

notes.scul: New riders start in plain words. Club pilots switch with Use SCUL words on the welcome card, or in Settings › Words.
notes.plain: New riders start in plain words. SCUL members switch with Use SCUL words on the welcome card, or in Settings › Words.

notes.scul: Space walks are saved to the Log with a walker mark, kept out of your light years.
notes.plain: Walks are saved to the Log with a walker mark, kept out of your bike miles.

notes.scul: Send feedback has an optional name field, and Consider comets in routing is on by default.
notes.plain: Send feedback has an optional name field, trains are considered in routing by default, and past rides no longer show on the map.

notes.scul: A course's preview draws its lines a little wider.
notes.plain: Route previews draw their lines a little wider.

notes.scul: Anchorages show from one zoom closer, so the chart stays clear; with the buttons on the left, the pills keep clear of your ship in landscape.
notes.plain: Bike racks show from one zoom closer, so the map stays clear; with the buttons on the left, the pills keep clear of you in landscape.

notes.scul: The round buttons stand in one column on your thumb's side (Settings › Buttons), with Launch beside them.
notes.plain: The round buttons stand in one column on your thumb's side (Settings › Buttons), with Record beside them.

notes.scul: One-way streets show small arrows, lit streets glow brighter on the dark chart, and comet stations take their line's colour.
notes.plain: One-way streets show small arrows, lit streets glow brighter on the dark map, T stations take their line's colour, and traffic lights look real.

notes.scul: Flying has new colours, one scale per theme: brighter is better on Dark, darker on Daystar.
notes.plain: Ride quality has new colours, one scale per theme: brighter is better on Dark, darker on Light.

notes.scul: A flight with a course lands by itself at the end, with Undo. A tiny flight goes by itself, with Keep, but never one with a GPS gap.
notes.plain: A ride with a route ends by itself when you arrive, with Undo. A tiny ride goes by itself, with Keep, but never one with a GPS gap.

notes.scul: Settings has new Power and Routing sections. Pick a ship, then its colour. The Arrow has no beam.
notes.plain: Settings has new Power and Routing sections. Pick a bike, then its colour. The Arrow has no beam.

notes.scul: Show on the chart glides out to the nearest few when none are in view, and kinds complete as you type: "post" offers Post offices.
notes.plain: Show on the map glides out to the nearest few when none are in view, and kinds complete as you type: "post" offers Post offices.

notes.scul: After a course preview, a drag during the glide back no longer leaves the chart off centre.
notes.plain: After a route preview, a drag during the glide back no longer leaves the map off centre.

notes: Settings is tidier: Calm motion has its own Accessibility section, Battery saver calms motion too, and the App rows are one flat list.
Developer has an icon legend: every map icon and what it means.

notes.scul: Radiation is drawn as streaks over a blue-grey tint, never green, and heavier radiation looks heavier.
notes.plain: Rain is drawn as streaks over a blue-grey tint, never green, and heavier rain looks heavier.

notes.scul: Explanations stay until you tap; with a peek open, a tap on the chart only closes it. With comets off, a station's peek lists its lines.
notes.plain: Explanations stay until you tap; with a pop-up open, a tap on the map only closes it. With trains off, a T stop lists its lines.

notes.scul: A place's peek can open it in OpenStreetMap, and a course's walked stretches show only footprints.
notes.plain: A place's pop-up can open it in OpenStreetMap, and a route's walked stretches show only footprints.

notes.scul: Settings › Pilot: two ships, two tall ships and a sleeker arrow, each matching an avatar in Plain. Lamps glow only on a dark chart.
notes.plain: Settings › Avatar: two racers, two basket bikes and a sleeker arrow. Lamps show only on a dark map, and the front lamp is white.

notes.scul: Daystar's wormholes and bike lanes are a bright blue, and at night the streets glow warm white, like a city seen from orbit.
notes.plain: In Light, bike lanes and paths are a bright blue. In Dark, streets are a warm white, like lit streets at night.

notes.scul: In flight, the pulsars on your course stay bright and the rest dim.
notes.plain: While you ride, the traffic lights on your route stay bright and the rest dim.

notes: A flat route's climb strip is drawn flat, so a few feet of rise no longer looks like a hill.

notes.scul: Vega and the other voices are stored ahead on mobile data too, so a turn call never waits on the network.
notes.plain: Warm and the other voices are stored ahead on mobile data too, so a turn call never waits on the network.

notes: Map icons are drawn at your screen's own sharpness on high-density phones, so they no longer look soft.
Cobbled and setts streets show their stones from close up.
A new home screen: Where to? on top, one row of round buttons at the bottom for weather, Layers, location, sound and the compass, and Settings is a tab.

notes.scul: Your course is coloured by how good the flying is, from red where it's rough to blue where it's smooth. The new Flying layer shows every starpath that way.
notes.plain: Your route is coloured by how good the riding is, from red where it's rough to blue where it's smooth. The new Ride quality layer shows every street that way.

notes.scul: In Plain words the voice is now Vega, the warm one, listed first, unless you've picked one. Lodestar stays SCUL's voice, and Mira is gone.
notes.plain: The voice is now Warm, listed first, unless you've picked one. Bright is gone: it took too long to say things. Try the others in Settings › Sound › Voice.

notes: A new app icon: a white bike on violet, with a gold star for its chainring. Installed apps pick it up after this update.

notes.scul: Stop signs are small red octagons, from the zoom where pulsars appear. Comet stations wear the MBTA's T, and pulsars lose their gold ring.
notes.plain: Stop signs are small red octagons, from the zoom where traffic lights appear. T stations wear the MBTA's T, and the lights lose their gold ring.

notes.scul: One icon per kind of place: pink where you pay, blue where it's free. Icons come in by zoom, street names first, and anchorages keep one icon.
notes.plain: One icon per kind of place: pink where you pay, blue where it's free. Icons come in by zoom, street names first, and bike racks keep one icon.

notes.scul: Comets are easier to see in Dark and Daystar: brighter tracks, longer tails, and each line's name on the chart.
notes.plain: Live T trains are easier to see in Dark and Light: brighter tracks, longer tails, and each line's name on the map.

notes.scul: Settings › Pilot: pick your pilot, not a colour. The ship, a rider with a basket, a racer, a cargo bike with a dog, or an arrow.
notes.plain: Settings › Avatar: pick your avatar, not a colour. A rider with a basket, a yellow bike, a racer, a cargo bike with a dog, or an arrow.

notes.scul: After sunset, courses lean toward lit streets and paths. Weekend Commuter Rail trains that take bikes now count too.
notes.plain: After sunset, routes lean toward lit streets and paths. Weekend Commuter Rail trains that take bikes now count too.

notes.scul: Settings › Sound › Voice: four new voices, each with a ▶ to hear it first. Vega, Rigel and Mira, and Burble for fun.
notes.plain: Settings › Sound › Voice: four new voices, each with a ▶ to hear it first. Warm, Calm and Bright, and Silly for fun.

notes: A snow or ice warning from the National Weather Service shows where No rain usually is, for as long as it lasts.

notes.scul: Search for a kind of place, like coolant, and Show on the chart lights them all. A tap elsewhere puts the chart back.
notes.plain: Search for a kind of place, like water, and Show on the map lights them all. A tap elsewhere puts the map back.

notes: Battery saver turns on by itself when the battery runs low, with Undo. Unpaved stretches show hatched on the course's height strip.
The Log opens quickly even with hundreds of rides, and the app downloads less when it starts.
Send feedback goes at once: the box empties and it says Sending…, then Sent. No waiting between messages.

notes.scul: Sandworm nest ahead: a callout where your course's bike lane passes a bus stop on your side.
notes.plain: Bus stop ahead: a callout where your route's bike lane passes a bus stop on your side.

notes.scul: Comets ride on their tracks, and a Comet Station's times keep each line's name whole.
notes.plain: Trains ride on their tracks, and a station's times keep each line's name whole.

notes: Bubbles and the cards you tap on the map have solid backgrounds, and any tap on empty space closes them. A card's star, share and avoid stack in a column.

notes.scul: Layers opens in full, the ×s stay in view, Calm motion is one switch in Appearance, and after an update a note links to What's new.
notes.plain: Layers opens in full, the ×s stay in view, Calm motion is one switch, a mile passes without a chime, and a note links to What's new.

notes: Bubbles close at your next tap elsewhere, or on Escape, and that tap still does what you aimed at.

notes.scul: With Bike lanes off in Layers, wormholes draw as plain paths instead of bright blue.
notes.plain: With Bike lanes off in Layers, bike paths draw as plain paths instead of bright blue.

notes: Pace in Settings changes only with its − and + buttons, so scrolling past it leaves it alone.
The Log draws your own average across its weeks and months.

notes.scul: The preview's fourth number is the transport-free share again: higher is better.
notes.plain: The preview's fourth number is the car-free share again: higher is better.

notes.scul: On a course, the arrival time and the minutes left are the big numbers, with speed and distance small.
notes.plain: On a route, the arrival time and the minutes left are the big numbers, with speed and distance small.

notes.scul: A free flight shows its time, distance and speed.
notes.plain: A ride with no destination shows its time, distance and speed.

notes.scul: In Plain words, the button for a ride with no destination says Record.
notes.plain: The button for a ride with no destination says Record.

notes: A stretch to walk shows as close dots when zoomed out, and as footprints when zoomed in.
Settings is in titled sections, and the (i) by a row explains it. The More page is gone.

notes.scul: Offline charts are one fold in Settings, and its line says what is stored.
notes.plain: Offline maps are one fold in Settings, and its line says what is stored.

notes: Bike lanes off in Layers hides every on-street lane.

notes.scul: Parks and water are brighter in Daystar.
notes.plain: Parks and water are brighter in Light.

notes: The Log has a card of your distance and climb for each of the last 12 weeks or months.
The empty search shows your starred places and your recent searches.
Starred places are marked in search results and listed in Settings.
Send feedback can attach what the app was doing. It never sends your location.
An installed app's home-screen icon now updates to the current one, within about a day.

notes.scul: Daystar is slate now: a grey ground with graphite starpaths.
notes.plain: The Light theme is slate now: a grey ground with graphite streets.

notes: Layers has a Bike lanes layer.

notes.scul: Anchorages are drawn as a bike lock.
notes.plain: Bike racks are drawn as a bike lock.

notes: The preview keeps From and To at the top, with a switch for bike or walk.

notes.scul: Its four numbers are time, length, climb and the share on starpaths with transports.
notes.plain: Its four numbers are time, length, climb and the share on streets with cars.

notes: The turn count and the arrival clock are off the preview.
Arrival times leave out the minutes you stand still at the start, and learn your own pace.

notes.scul: Stop signs are called out, as pulsars are.
notes.plain: Stop signs are called out, as traffic lights are.

notes.scul: In flight on a course, the readout shows the arrival time and the time left.
notes.plain: On a route, the readout shows the arrival time and the time left.

notes.scul: Walking stretches show as footprints, and the course is always orange.
notes.plain: Walking stretches show as footprints, and the route is always orange.

notes.scul: Settings has Pilot color, the color of your marker.
notes.plain: Settings has Avatar color, the color of your marker.

notes.scul: At sunset the preview puts the sunset time beside the arrival time, so more of the chart stays in view.
notes.plain: At sunset the preview puts the sunset time beside the arrival time, so more of the map stays in view.

notes.scul: Long trips plan several times faster with Wormholes and Quickest, and the courses are the same.
notes.plain: Long trips plan several times faster with Bike paths and Quickest, and the routes are the same.

notes: Trips into a stored map pack plan just as fast.

notes.scul: A tap on the course shows the starpath it runs on there. A hold still moves the course.
notes.plain: A tap on the route shows the street it runs on there. A hold still moves the route.

notes: Each popup's arrow points at what it names.
Trips plan faster again.
The preview shows each route card as soon as it's ready, so the first one comes sooner.
Map packs: store more of Massachusetts from Settings, from Central MA to the South Coast, plus Hull and Nahant.
Search finds towns across the state. A place in a pack you haven't stored offers to get that pack.

notes.scul: A stored pack draws on the chart, and courses run into it.
notes.plain: A stored pack draws on the map, and routes run into it.

notes.scul: On a flat chart, your ship stands up a little toward you.
notes.plain: On a flat map, your marker stands up a little toward you.

notes.scul: Starpaths you avoid show on the chart, and Settings lists them with their dates and a Clear all.
notes.plain: Streets you avoid show on the map, and Settings lists them with their dates and a Clear all.

notes: Starred places show from farther out, small at first.
